---
title: "Innovation, Growth, and the Environment"
author: "Robin Burgess, Stefano Caria, Tim Dobermann, Edoardo Saggese"
date: "2023-01-01"
categories: [environment, growth, innovation]
description: >
  An IGC white paper examining how innovation policy can be directed toward
  environmental goals without sacrificing growth in low- and middle-income
  countries.
---

**Summary.** This paper sets out how green innovation and growth-enhancing
industrial policy can be combined in developing-country contexts, drawing on
IGC research on energy, environment, and structural transformation.

[Read on the IGC website →](https://www.theigc.org/news/innovation-growth-and-environment){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}
